notes.title: :3 Released!
notes.notes:
[p]Thanks for being here, and reading this. This is exciting, the game is finally released and playable and you get to see what we made! This one is special to me personally (Haphestia) because it's... kind of my story, in a sense.[/p][p][/p][p]There's a free demo - if you own the full game and want to play with the demo for fun, you can press CTRL+D from the title screen to flip the game into Demo mode (but installing the demo separately also works fine).  The demo has a 10:00 time limit per session, and doesn't allow saving, but is otherwise rather fully-featured. And the timer only counts actual gameplay time, time spent paused or in a menu or the overworld won't count.[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to hang out with us in Discord, please come on in! [url="https://discord.gg/VwM3sZWqxC"]https://discord.gg/VwM3sZWqxC[/url]
And if anyone wants to stream this game on Twitch, please let me know, I'd love to come hang out.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
